name: pumasi-sign
description: Not the product's package. This file exists so that pumasi/tools/gate.sh -- the charter's executable merge gate, whose step 1 runs `npm test` at the repository root -- runs this repository's real suite instead of failing on a missing package.json. It deliberately carries NO `version` field: one version number, in the root package.json, user-visible and in every feedback report, is PRODUCT-RULES.md PR-1 and roadmap/BACKLOG.md item 6, and setting it here would take the product manager's next item in a packet that is not scoped to it. Frozen acceptance case A-208 asserts the absence so a later packet cannot take it in passing. `test` runs BOTH trees this repository ships (pumasi/DECISIONS.md Q-018): `test:frontend` is the SPA's vitest suite plus its type-check, and `test:service` is the Cloudflare Worker in service/ -- the tree that answers sign.pumasi.ai -- installed, built, run, and then proved to have run by .github/scripts/assert-service-suite-ran.sh, the same guard ci.yaml's `service` job uses. Before spec/0003 this script ran the frontend half only, so `GATE: PASS` could be printed off zero assertions against production (roadmap/BACKLOG.md item 2, Q-025 rider (a)). The type-check is `vue-tsc -b --force`, NOT `vue-tsc --noEmit`: frontend/tsconfig.json is a solution file (empty `files` plus `references`), so without `-b` vue-tsc checks nothing and exits 0 on a tree with type errors -- measured, not assumed. Still not run here, and gated by .github/workflows/ci.yaml instead: backend pytest (needs Postgres on :5433) and the Playwright e2e job (needs the built container). That split is stated rather than left for a reader to discover -- and note that the e2e job drives backend/, which is not what users reach.

scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:service
scripts.test:frontend: cd frontend && npm run test:unit && npx vue-tsc -b --force
